translations.web: For it is commendable if someone endures pain, suffering unjustly, because of conscience toward God.
translations.bsb: For if anyone endures the pain of unjust suffering because he is conscious of God, this is to be commended.
translations.kjv: For this is thankworthy, if a man for conscience toward God endure grief, suffering wrongfully.
translations.asv: For this is acceptable, if for conscience toward God a man endureth griefs, suffering wrongfully.
